transaction_fees.note: Priority fees are per compute unit in micro-lamports. Median total assumes a 200k CU transaction with one signature.

activity.note: Unique fee payers across sampled blocks -- an activity indicator, not a 24h unique-address count.

fees.note: REV = network fees (DeFiLlama 'Chain' category) + out-of-protocol MEV tips ('MEV' category). app_fees is the separate, much larger figure for fees earned by applications on Solana.

ecosystem.note: Official solana.com metric feed. Keyless and unauthenticated; republishes provider-computed analytics including Dune.

items.title: Solana Changelog: August 6, 2026
items.summary: Agave, Firedancer, Frankendancer, SDK, and testing-tool releases shipped as 350ms slot-time gates reached Devnet and Testnet.

items.title: Webinar Recap: Giving AI agents a native way to pay with x402
items.summary: X402 has processed roughly 200M transactions and $50B in volume, giving AI agents a stablecoin-native way to pay for web resources.

items.title: Solana Ecosystem Roundup: July 2026
items.summary: Tokenized equities expanded, real-world assets hit $3.73B, payments reached 330,000+ merchants, and block capacity increased 66% in a milestone month.

items.title: Breakpoint 2026: The Token Supercycle
